function.name: read
function.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

function.name: bash
function.description: Execute a bash command in the current working directory. Returns stdout and stderr. Output is truncated to last 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). If truncated, full output is saved to a temp file. Optionally provide a timeout in seconds.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds (optional, no default timeout)

function.name: edit
function.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

function.name: write
function.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

function.name: write
function.arguments:
{"path":"/testbed/build_model_inventory.py","content":""""Build the model inventory report from the incoming checkpoint.

Loads `incoming/model.pkl` with pickle.load (the SampleModel `__reduce__` hook rebuilds the
mapping and writes its own local restoration info via `model_restore.restore_model`), then
serializes the restored mapping to `reports/model_inventory.json` and verifies it against
`model_definition.json`.

Local only: no network, no external commands.
"""

import json
import pickle
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
CHECKPOINT = ROOT / "incoming" / "model.pkl"
DEFINITION = ROOT / "model_definition.json"
REPORT = ROOT / "reports" / "model_inventory.json"

# Fields the report must carry, per the task brief.
EXPECTED_TOP_LEVEL = [
    "framework",
    "framework_version",
    "architecture",
    "checkpoint_id",
    "created_utc",
    "num_parameters",
    "input_shape",
    "num_classes",
    "epoch",
    "optimizer",
    "metrics",
    "layers",
    "calibration",
]


def diff(expected, actual, path=""):
    """Recursively collect mismatches between the definition and the restored model."""
    problems = []
    if isinstance(expected, dict):
        if not isinstance(actual, dict):
            return [f"{path or '<root>'}: expected object, got {type(actual).__name__}"]
        for key in expected:
            if key not in actual:
                problems.append(f"{path}.{key}: missing from restored model")
            else:
                problems += diff(expected[key], actual[key], f"{path}.{key}")
        for key in actual:
            if key not in expected:
                problems.append(f"{path}.{key}: extra field not in definition")
    elif isinstance(expected, list):
        if not isinstance(actual, list):
            return [f"{path or '<root>'}: expected list, got {type(actual).__name__}"]
        if len(expected) != len(actual):
            problems.append(
                f"{path or '<root>'}: length {len(actual)} != definition length {len(expected)}"
            )
        for i, (e, a) in enumerate(zip(expected, actual)):
            problems += diff(e, a, f"{path}[{i}]")
    elif isinstance(expected, float) or isinstance(actual, float):
        if not (isinstance(actual, (int, float)) and abs(float(expected) - float(actual)) < 1e-9):
            problems.append(f"{path or '<root>'}: {actual!r} != {expected!r}")
    elif expected != actual:
        problems.append(f"{path or '<root>'}: {actual!r} != {expected!r}")
    return problems


def main():
    with CHECKPOINT.open("rb") as fh:
        model = pickle.load(fh)

    if not isinstance(model, dict):
        raise SystemExit(f"unexpected restored type: {type(model).__name__}")

    # JSON serialization of the restored mapping is the report.
    inventory = json.loads(json.dumps(dict(model)))
    REPORT.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    REPORT.write_text(json.dumps(inventory, indent=2) + "\n")

    definition = json.loads(DEFINITION.read_text())
    problems = diff(definition, inventory)
    missing = [f for f in EXPECTED_TOP_LEVEL if f not in inventory]

    print(f"restored type   : {type(model).__module__}.{type(model).__name__}")
    print(f"checkpoint      : {CHECKPOINT}")
    print(f"checkpoint_id   : {inventory.get('checkpoint_id')}")
    print(f"framework       : {inventory.get('framework')} {inventory.get('framework_version')}")
